E-commerce wave cutoff moved from 14:00 to 15:00.
Batch picking enabled for zones A and B.
Count frequency increased to weekly for high-variance zones.
Receiving dock capacity adjusted from 30 to 25 inbound per day.
ASN interface updated to include pallet-level data.
WMS patch 9.2.4 applied in the Saturday maintenance window.
